description: NaInF₆(NH₄)₂ is alpha Rhenium trioxide-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight NH₄ clusters inside a NaInF₆ framework. In each NH₄ cluster, N is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent H atoms. All N-H bond lengths are 1.03 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the NaInF₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent InF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.26 Å. In is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form InF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All In-F bond lengths are 2.12 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one In atom.
